label: Portrait framing
description: How a portrait of one person is framed: how much of them shows, where they sit in the frame and how the camera faces them.
notes: DRAFT. One whole framing per value: crop, placement and camera position together, in plain words for what is visible. No pose (person.pose), lens, focus or lighting words. Closed: generated framings drift back to 'close-up portrait'. Supersedes camera.shot_size and camera.angle for portraits.
